summary: Completed E2E testing of Attendance Policy Configuration feature in Business Rules UI. Fixed backend bug where `elif` chain prevented multiple rule updates. Added missing AT009-AT012 rules to existing attendance policy. All backend APIs (10/10) and frontend UI elements verified working.
seed_data_creation: Added missing AT009-AT012 rules to company attendance policy via POST /api/business-rules/{policy_id}/rule endpoint
context_for_next_testing_agent: Attendance Policy Configuration is fully functional. The Attendance Policies tab shows the configuration panel with: Working Days selector (Mon-Sun toggleable buttons), Core Hours dropdowns (Start/End time), Grace Period input, WFH Days/Week input, Grace Days/Month input, Late Penalty input, Save Configuration button, Add Override button, and Policy Overrides section showing existing consultant role override.

attendance_config_panel.visibility: PASS - Panel shows when clicking Attendance Policies tab
attendance_config_panel.core_hours_dropdowns: PASS - Start Time and End Time dropdowns with valid options
attendance_config_panel.add_override_button: PASS - Opens dialog for role-wise/employee-wise overrides
attendance_config_panel.overrides_display: PASS - Shows existing consultant role override

api_test_results.GET /api/business-rules/attendance/confi: PASS - Returns working_days, core_hours, grace_period, wfh_days, etc.
api_test_results.PUT /api/business-rules/attendance/confi: PASS - Updates config and returns changes list
api_test_results.GET /api/business-rules/attendance/overr: PASS - Returns role_overrides and employee_overrides arrays
api_test_results.POST /api/business-rules/attendance/over: PASS - Creates role-wise or employee-wise override

bug_fixed.issue: Backend PUT /api/business-rules/attendance/config was not updating rules correctly
bug_fixed.root_cause: The code used `elif` chain for rule updates, meaning only the first matching rule_id would be updated per request
bug_fixed.fix_applied: Changed `elif` to `if` statements so each rule is checked independently

data_migration.issue: Existing company attendance policy was missing AT009-AT012 rules
data_migration.fix_applied: Added missing rules via POST /api/business-rules/{policy_id}/rule endpoint
